messages:
Maya Chen: Quick sync: GA launch readiness for telemetry + billing. Need owners and acceptance checks before Friday.
Tony Alvarez: I'll take billing export validation and the sample invoice pipeline. Will post schema samples.
Rachel Li: I'll own docs and runbooks. Need a minimal 'fast path' for common incidents (fallback variant, rate-limit handling, billing disputes).
Jordan (ops-bot): deploy-bot: preflight: telemetry hooks deployed, sample events forwarding to telemetry-prod.
Samir Patel: Acceptance checklist proposal:
- SLA copy ready
- Docs + runbook linked
- Token-level telemetry with p50/p95 latency by route
- Billing export validated across 3 pilots
- Cost alerts + safety runway
- Support roster + escalation drill
Eliza Gomez: add: soft warning at 85% budget and paging at 125%. Also need rollback for runaway invoicing.
Maya Chen: Fill owners inline please.
Tony Alvarez: Owners:
- Billing export schema & reconciliation -> Tony
- Pricing smoke tests -> Tony
- Invoice preview -> Tony
- Schema docs -> Tony & Rachel
Rachel Li: Owners:
- Runbooks & escalation play -> Rachel
- Public API error docs -> Rachel & Eliza
Samir Patel: Telemetry specifics:
- per-route token cost estimate (avg/p95)
- per-model latency p50/p95
- projected daily spend per customer
- sampling: metadata 100%, token payloads 1% retained
Alert prototype:
```
alert: PotentialBillingSpike
expr: sum(estimated_daily_cost) by (customer) > (customer_budget * 1.15)
for: 15m
labels:
  severity: page
```
Eliza Gomez: soft: 85% -> annotation/email; hard: 125% -> page.
Maya Chen: SLO targets: hosted tier p95 token latency < 300ms, error rate < 0.5%.
Jordan (ops-bot): deploy-bot: telemetry hooks OK, rule dry-run OK, billing export job scheduled.
Rachel Li: Docs checklist:
- examples for common errors and retries
- explaining cost fields and estimations
- runbook with contacts for billing/eng/account
- migration notes for legacy customers
Tony Alvarez: Billing validation plan:
1) export -> parquet schema v2
2) reconcile with billing-staging (delta < 1%)
3) send invoice previews to pilots
Samir Patel: propose automated smoke: claim 10k tokens across routes during business hours and assert billing delta < threshold. Catches mapping/regression.
Tony Alvarez: can add scheduled replay + smoke job. i'll own it.
Eliza Gomez: Support test: simulate quota-exceeded customer and validate support opens priority ticket < 30m and engages eng per runbook.
Rachel Li: i'll schedule a tabletop with support & oncall next wednesday.
Maya Chen: Final acceptance gates:
- owners marked done
- billing export validated end-to-end on 3 pilots
- telemetry retention & sampling configured and documented
- cost alerts with escalation workflow
- tabletop runbook completed
- SLOs documented and smoke-tests passing
Samir Patel: Action items:
- Tony: billing export + smoke job (ETA Thu)
- Rachel: runbook + docs tabletop (ETA Wed)
- Tony & Samir: cost alert thresholds + dry-run (ETA Thu)
- Eliza: support escalation test (ETA Wed post-tabletop)
Maya Chen: Aim to clear gates by Friday COB. Call out any slips immediately.
Tony Alvarez: will post status update tomorrow.
Rachel Li: docs PR updated with runbook draft tonight.
Jordan (ops-bot): deploy-bot: preflight summary: telemetry OK, alert dry-run OK, billing jobs queued.
Maya Chen: thanks team :thumbsup:
Eliza Gomez: one more: include public docs line about customer cost controls (hard cap, email alerts, partner contacts).
Rachel Li: will add and link to billing controls UI.
Samir Patel: final note: retain event telemetry 90 days, billing records 1 year for reconciliation.
Maya Chen: noted. good progress.
